_note: German copy for the landing page. Terminology follows locales/de.json and store-listing-de.md so the site, the app and the Play listing use the same words: Abo and Abonnement, Testphase not Probeabo, Verlaengerung for a renewal, du not Sie. No dash is used as clause-separating punctuation. Longest-first replacement is handled by the builder, so substrings of other entries are safe here.
_note_punctuation: WATCH SENTENCES SPLIT ACROSS TWO KEYS. The hero is one sentence broken over a <span>, so English 'See what is coming' + 'before you pay.' became German with no comma before 'bevor', which German requires. The comma now lives at the end of the first fragment. Any future entry that is half a sentence has to carry the punctuation the German needs, because neither half can see the other.
